evan (customer-success): paging — Orion Finance reports that their VPC gateway streaming connections are dropping repeatedly since ~09:02 UTC. Impacting payment confirmation streams (customers see partial responses then WS close 1006). Customer says retries are causing duplicate payment intents. CID=orion-prod-42 

incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 created — ORION-VPC-WEBSOCKETS. Pager: @sam (oncall). Incident doc: https://incidents.redwood.internal/ORION-VPC-WEBSOCKETS. Runbook: app/gateway/streaming-timeouts.

sam (oncall): ack — I'm on it. @evan can you paste a sample x-request-id or session_id from the customer? also any recent deploys?

evan (customer-success): sending sample from user report: x-request-id=orion-7f3b2, session_id=ws_1992. No deploys reported from Orion. They said this started after spike in traffic at ~08:58 UTC.

raj (infra): looking at dp-orion-prod (dedicated pool). Seeing a huge bump in concurrent websocket sessions -> backend GPU workers hit file-descriptor limits then reconnect storm. Metrics: ws_accept_errors spike 09:01 -> 09:05, reconnect_rate x20, p95 latency 2.3s -> 8.7s.

maria (eng-sre): probable root: NGINX proxy upstream timeout + insufficient worker_fds on pool nodes. Two mitigation levers: 1) increase proxy timeout + keepalive to reduce teardown churn, 2) scale dp-orion-prod to absorb burst and adjust ulimit. Also consider temporary per-tenant connection cap to avoid noisy neighbor.

tess (support): customer impact: payments pipeline retries after WS close. They've paused accepting new transactions but need a fix fast. :grimacing: 

sam (oncall): ok, immediate steps:
- apply NGINX timeout bump on VPC gateway layer
- scale dedicated pool from 3 -> 6 replicas
- enable fallback to HTTP long-poll for streams >45s for Orion tenant

sam (oncall): applying nginx tweak now on gw-orion-vpc: ```
# snippet
kubectl exec -n gateway gw-orion-vpc -- sed -n '1,200p' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf | sed 's/keepalive_timeout 15;/keepalive_timeout 45;/' > /tmp/nginx.conf && kubectl cp /tmp/nginx.conf gw-orion-vpc:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf && kubectl exec -n gateway gw-orion-vpc -- nginx -s reload
```

raj (infra): scaling dp-orion-prod: ```
kubectl -n prod scale deployment dp-orion-prod --replicas=6
# output: deployment.apps/dp-orion-prod scaled
```

maria (eng-sre): adding per-tenant cap and fallback policy. Patching policy-router: ```
PATCH /v1/router/policies/orion
{
  "tenant": "orion",
  "max_concurrent_ws": 1200,
  "fallback": {
    "type": "long_poll",
    "threshold_s": 45
  }
}
```
(we'll roll this as a quick patch, then roll back if it causes issues)

sam (oncall): applied stickiness + cap. Observing immediate drop in reconnect_rate. ws_accept_errors down 60% in 3 minutes. dp-orion-prod pods healthy 6/6. p95 latency back to ~2.0s.

evan (customer-success): told Orion we applied mitigations (timeout bump, scaled pool, fallback policy). They're running tests now. They asked for rollback plan if polling breaks their UX.

maria (eng-sre): rollback plan: revert router policy and scale back dp-orion-prod -> 3. Commands noted in runbook. Also to investigate root cause: likely fd ulimit + upstream keepalive misconfig under bursts. Will open an infra follow-up ticket.

tess (support): Orion reports reduced error rate on their side, payments pipeline resumed with manual checks. Asking for ETA on permanent fix.

sam (oncall): will stay on for next 30m then hand off to @raj (overnight). Updating incident doc with timestamps and actions. If customer sees any duplicate charges, escalate to legal/ops.

incident-bot: oncall handoff scheduled — new owner: raj (infra). Handoff window starts at 09:25 UTC.

raj (infra): ack takeover. I'll run a full post-incident check: ulimit across nodes, kernel TCP settings, nginx keepalive behavior, and ensure autoscaler triggers earlier on RTT increases.

evan (customer-success): thanks team. I'll send a customer-facing summary and follow up at 11:00 UTC with status. Marking P1 -> mitigating. :white_check_mark:

sam (oncall): closing realtime paging for now, leaving doc open for postmortem. Great job everyone.

maria (eng-sre): created follow-up ticket INF-4589 for config hardening, and assigned to infra team.

final note (evan (customer-success)): Orion asks for a technical postmortem and a slide for their execs; will coordinate with eng on timing.
